findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The dish machine is observed to only be reaching a heat-sanitizing temperature of 122F. The facility has a triple sink that will be used to sanitize the dishes in. A follow up is scheduled for 9/22/2026 to ensure that the dish machine is reaching a heat-sanitizing temperature of at least 160F.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(B) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (B) Hot water mechanical operations by being cycled through EQUIPMENT that is set up as specified under §§ 4-501.15, 4-501.112, and 4-501.113 and achieving a UTENSIL surface temperature of 71°C (160°F) as measured by an irreversible registering temperature indicator.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are in need of repair: 

1. There is a broken piece of coving to the left of the handwashing sink in the kitchen. Ensure that this is repaired. 
2. The facility has a new handwashing sink in the kitchen. There needs to be caulking around the handwashing sink to seal it to the wall. 
3. The plate under the handwashing sink in the kitchen is observed to be coming away from the wall. Ensure that this is sealed. 

Ensure all physical facilities are repaired and maintained in good repair. Ensure that all repairs are made to be smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.112(A) Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Hot Water Sanitization Temperatures. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, in a mechanical operation, the temperature of the fresh hot water SANITIZING rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 90°C (194°F), or less than: (1) For a stationary rack, single temperature machine, 74°C (165°F); or (2) For all other machines, 82°C (180°F). 

It was observed that the dish machine is not reaching a heat sanitizing temperature of above 150F. A follow up is scheduled for 2/10/2025 to ensure that the dish machine is reaching a temperature of above 160F. Ensure that dish machines are properly sanitizing dishes by reaching a temperature of 160F or above.
